maxResolve.name: Maximum Resolve Points
maxResolve.hint: Resolve Points every character has each day (2 to 6). Companions keep 3, or this number if it is lower; rivals keep 2. It sets the length of the adventuring day.

resolveByLevel.name: Resolve by level
resolveByLevel.hint: 4 Resolve Points through 8th level and 3 from 9th level, whatever the maximum above says.

havens.name: Havens
havens.hint: Adds the haven to the kinds of night: a night at an inn, a hall or a friendly hearth restores twice the Hit Points.

grimWounds.name: Grim Wounds
grimWounds.hint: Persistent bleed damage and damage taken while unconscious skip Stamina Points. Falling damage can't be recognised: apply it with Direct damage on the sheet.

generousSupplies.name: Generous Supplies
generousSupplies.hint: Healing from every item (potions, scrolls, wands, staves) is spent healing and costs the patient nothing.

recurringRivals.name: Recurring Rivals
recurringRivals.hint: Lets the GM mark an NPC as a rival with two pools and 2 Resolve Points.

lingeringWounds.name: Lingering Wounds
lingeringWounds.hint: A breather that would end the wounded condition lowers it by 1 instead, to a minimum of 1. A night still ends it.

levelGroundDCs.name: Level Ground DCs
levelGroundDCs.hint: Treat Wounds and Battle Medicine use DCs 14, 16, 18 and 20, and Assurance gives 10 + the proficiency bonus without level. Automatic follows the Level Ground feature.

healingPrompt.name: Ask when healing is applied
healingPrompt.hint: Who sees the spent / paid dialog when healing is applied to a creature with two pools. When unsure: only for a source the module can't classify, or an infused item.

redirectSystemActions.name: Replace the system's actions
redirectSystemActions.hint: pf2e's Take a Breather, Steel Your Resolve, Treat Wounds and Encouraging Words open this variant's commands instead. The rules say the system's breather and Steel Your Resolve must not be used.

actionHint.catch: 1 action, 1 Resolve Point, once per breather: regain half your maximum Stamina Points or 5.
actionHint.steel: Once per day: Catch Your Breath without spending a Resolve Point.
actionHint.bind: End a breather spent tending your own wounds: 1 Resolve Point for a quarter of your maximum Hit Points.
actionHint.holdOn: Free action, 1 Resolve Point: the recovery check is a success without a roll.
actionHint.lend: 1 action (none in a shared breather): give your targeted ally 1 Resolve Point.
actionHint.words: 1 action: your targeted ally regains 5 + twice your level Stamina Points.
actionHint.treat: Open Treat Wounds with this character as the healer.
actionHint.battle: Open Battle Medicine with this character as the healer.
actionHint.rest: Open the Rest window: end a breather, or a night.

refuse.noHeal: {name} can't regain Hit Points right now.
refuse.caught: Already caught their breath this breather.
refuse.self: The two share one set of Resolve Points.
refuse.lent: {name} has already received Lend Strength since their last night.
refuse.immune: {name} is immune to Encouraging Words until their next night.
refuse.notTwoPools: {name} has one pool: use the printed rules.
refuse.steelUsed: Steel Your Resolve is used for today.
refuse.variantOff: The Stamina variant is off: Breath and Blood does nothing until the GM turns it on.
refuse.tooMany: This treatment takes at most {limit} patients.
refuse.bmImmune: Immune to this healer's Battle Medicine for today.
refuse.noRank: The healer isn't trained in Medicine.

gm.returnedHint: Set Resolve Points and Stamina Points to 0. Set Hit Points as the effect states.
gm.directHint: Damage to temporary Hit Points, then Hit Points, skipping Stamina Points: falling (Grim Wounds), damage that can't be healed, a healer's price.

rest.title: Breath and Blood: rest
rest.none: No character with two pools that you own.
rest.lede: End a breather after 10 uninterrupted minutes of rest in one place. A night is chosen per character.
rest.endBreatherHint: Wake, regain Stamina Points, clear caught breath and end or lower wounded, for the ticked characters.
rest.nightHint: Run the system's Rest for the Night, then set Resolve Points by the kind of night and end wounded.

setup.off: The pf2e Stamina variant is off. Breath and Blood changes nothing until the GM turns it on.
setup.lasting: Lasting Wounds (PF2e Variant Rules) is switched on. Breath and Blood replaces it and it applies nothing while this feature runs; switch it off in the Control Center.
setup.lede: Breath and Blood builds on pf2e's Stamina variant setting and never turns it on by itself.
setup.fillHint: {count} characters have 0 Stamina and 0 Resolve Points, as they do just after the variant is turned on.
setup.promptBody: Breath and Blood needs pf2e's Stamina variant, which is off. Turn it on now? Every character is prepared again; their Stamina and Resolve Points start at 0 until filled from the Setup tab of the Rest window.

treat.title: Treat Wounds
treat.surgeonUsed: Field Surgeon is used for today.
treat.surgeonBattle: Field Surgeon applies to Treat Wounds only.
treat.noPatients: Target or select the patients, then press From targets.
treat.lede: Each patient decides before the check: a patient who hasn't declined pays 1 Resolve Point. One check and one roll for all ({limit} at most). No immunity.
treat.ledeBattle: The patient decides before the check. The patient is then immune to this healer's Battle Medicine for 1 day, paid or not.
treat.previewSurgeon: Field Surgeon: pays nothing, at least {minimum} HP

heal.title: Healing {name}
heal.paidRule: Paid healing restores Hit Points only, at least {minimum}. {rp} Resolve Points now.
heal.spentRule: Spent healing costs nothing; what is left after Hit Points restores Stamina Points.
heal.repeating: This healing repeats: the choice covers it until it ends or the next breather (1 minute for a permanent source).

why.embedded: A spell from a scroll, wand or staff is paid healing.
why.generous: Generous Supplies: healing from items is spent.
why.focus: A focus spell is paid healing.
why.slot: A spell from a slot is spent healing.
why.innateLimited: An innate spell with uses per day is spent healing.
why.atWill: Healing usable at will is paid healing.
why.unknownSpell: This spell's casting can't be read: choose the kind.
why.infused: Infused: made at today's preparations, so spent. Change it for an item made otherwise.
why.perDay: An ability with uses per day is spent healing.
why.unknown: The source of this healing isn't known: choose the kind.
why.repeating: Healing that repeats: one decision for the whole effect.
why.covered: Covered by the payment made when the effect began.

unpaid.noHeal: Unpaid: this creature can't regain Hit Points.
unpaid.fullHP: Unpaid: already at maximum Hit Points.

holdOn.title: {name}: recovery check
holdOn.rule: Hold On: spend 1 Resolve Point, make no roll; the check is a success and dying drops by 1.

direct.lede: Direct damage to {name}: temporary Hit Points, then Hit Points. Stamina Points are skipped.

card.oneHP: At 0 Hit Points: exactly 1 Hit Point.
card.steel: Steel Your Resolve: no Resolve Point spent.
card.surge: Surge: one Stride or Strike as part of this action.
card.holdOn: No roll: the recovery check succeeds. Dying {dying}.
card.stabilized: Dying ends; unconscious at 0 Hit Points. Wounded {wounded}.
card.lendFree: During a shared breather: no action.
card.wordsImmune: Immune to Encouraging Words until their next night.
card.bind: Bound their own wounds: +{hp} HP, 1 Resolve Point.
card.noSP: At 0 Hit Points: no Stamina Points.
card.woundedStays: Wounded {value} stays: no Hit Points regained since the last encounter, and not at maximum.

night.haven: A haven: twice the Hit Points.

card.noCheck: Nobody paid: no check was made.
card.bmImmune: Immune to {healer}'s Battle Medicine for 1 day.

effect.words: Encouraging Words (immune until the next night)

notify.noGM: No GM is connected to carry this out.
